source_clause: PVAL2.1) Valet Mode button is greyed out while the vehicle is in motion. If the button is pushed while greyed out, a popup will indicate that the function is not available (Pop-up ID PU0091).
leaf_desc_037: PVAL2.1) Valet Mode button is greyed out while the vehicle is in motion. If the button is pushed while greyed out, a popup will indicate that the function is not available (Pop-up ID PU0091).
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.2.1（PVAL2.1）—— 行車中 Valet Mode 按鈕變灰；按下已變灰之按鈕時顯示 PU0091。關鍵情境條件：以靜止時可選為基準線（§5.6），判準為靜止→行進之狀態轉換（§12 首匹配 → 狀態轉換）。為什麼這樣切：變灰與按下之提示為同一條件下之兩個結果，037 未再切分，故併為一條（§5.7）。

tcs.tc_title: Valet Mode button greyed out while the vehicle is in motion
tcs.test_item: Valet Mode button greyed out while the vehicle is in motion
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is not active
2. The vehicle is stationary on a test track and can be brought into motion
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “All Profiles” tab and read the Valet Mode button
2. Bring the vehicle into motion
3. Read the Valet Mode button and press it
4. Read the screen and check that the unavailability popup is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Valet Mode button is selectable while stationary
2. The vehicle is in motion
3. The Valet Mode button is greyed out
4. PU0091 indicates that the function is not available
tcs.priority_basis: 行車中之啟用限制分支（**rubric 無安全帶，見上繳 19 §7**）
